characters.name: 江野
characters.design: Jiang Ye: 16-year-old male teenage table tennis player, short wet messy hair sticking to forehead, red sweat-soaked tight jersey clinging to back, kinesiology tape wrapped around wrist, stubborn determined eyes, lean athletic build, full body front view, realistic gritty texture, consistent with mixed warm tungsten and cool morning light in the gym.

issues: 手腕处应为肌内效贴（kinesiology tape），画面显示为黑色护腕（wristband）

characters.name: 江建军
characters.design: Jiang Jianjian: 45-year-old male former provincial team trainer, buzz cut with a few white strands, worn old sports jacket with frayed cuffs showing polished worn leather texture, hard defined forearm muscles, expressionless stern face, athletic build, full body front view, realistic gritty texture, matching the gym's mixed lighting.

props.name: 乒乓球拍
props.design: Table tennis racket: standard competition racket with red rubber surface, worn handle with sweat stains, scuff marks from being dropped on the floor, realistic textured surface, full object view, consistent with gritty sports documentary style.

props.name: 成筐乒乓球
props.design: Basket of table tennis balls: woven plastic basket filled with dozens of white standard table tennis balls, some with minor scuff marks, placed against the old gym wall, realistic texture, full object view, matching the worn gym aesthetic.

issues: 设计要点为编织塑料筐（woven plastic basket），画面为藤编篮（wicker basket）

props.name: 旧奖旗
props.design: Faded old championship banner: fabric banner with worn faded printed championship text and logos, hanging on the gym wall, slightly tattered edges, realistic texture, full object view, consistent with the nostalgic gym setting.

issues: 横幅文字应为可识别的冠军文字，画面文字为乱码/不可读

scenes.name: 老球馆
scenes.design: Old training gym: scuffed worn wooden floor, high ceiling with warm tungsten floodlights, high windows with cool first morning light streaming in, wall with faded old championship banners, baskets of table tennis balls by the wall, realistic gritty cinematic texture, wide shot environment view, high contrast lighting matching the cinematic grade.
